command_line:
set +e
set -u
python3 --version > probe.txt 2>&1
python3 -m pip --version >> probe.txt 2>&1
python3 -m pip install --disable-pip-version-check --no-user --no-deps --target "$PWD/.deps" 'caper==2.3.2' >> probe.txt 2>&1
printf 'pip_rc=%s\n' "$?" >> probe.txt
PATH="$PWD/.deps/bin:$PATH" PYTHONPATH="$PWD/.deps:/software/atac-seq-pipeline/src" python3 -c 'import caper; print(caper.__version__)' >> probe.txt 2>&1
printf 'import_rc=%s\n' "$?" >> probe.txt
PATH="$PWD/.deps/bin:$PATH" PYTHONPATH="$PWD/.deps:/software/atac-seq-pipeline/src" caper --version >> probe.txt 2>&1
printf 'cli_rc=%s\n' "$?" >> probe.txt
for cmd in encode_task_bowtie2.py encode_task_call_peak.py encode_task_idr.py encode_task_qc_report.py bowtie2 samtools bedtools macs2 idr; do
  command -v "$cmd" >> probe.txt 2>&1
  printf '%s_rc=%s\n' "$cmd" "$?" >> probe.txt
done
exit 0
